complexity.notes: Correct but slightly wasteful: it materializes full per-level lists when only the last node of each level is needed; peeking at current_frontier[-1] per level (or doing DFS right-first while tracking depth) avoids the intermediate lists, though the queue still costs O(n). The helper relies on deque/Optional/List being available from the LeetCode preamble, which is idiomatic there.
complexity.summary: Runs an iterative BFS to build every level of the tree as a list, then returns the last node value of each level, which is exactly the right-side view.
